body.message:
Hey guys,

I’m Edoardo M. T. Stabellini, CEO of Urbanhoo S.r.l. from Italy
For the past 5 years, we’ve been managing properties across Italy, Switzerland and Austria.

I’d like to talk with your CEO about a new project we’re launching for a state-of-the-art PMS that costs only 48aed/mo per property instead of 160aed/mo like Hostaway or Guesty but has not only the same features but even better ones for our type of job.

If it could be interesting for him/her just pass them this message and it would be awesome to connect.

Thank you and have a great day 🙂
